readme:
# TechJob.dk Scraper Scrape jobs from TechJob ([techjob.dk](https://techjob.dk/)), the Danish job board for engineers and IT people, run by Ingeniøren. You get the title, company, job type (permanent, internship, student job and so on), location, logo and the "new job" and "top job" marks for every job. Search by keyword, job category, job type, language, location with radius, company and application deadline, or give result page addresses of the site. ## What you get - One row per job, with the company page, the logo and the job address. - Each job once per run, even when several keywords, categories or start URLs find it. - A run with no input returns 5 jobs for the keyword python. - List data by default. Turn on `includeDetails` to also read the job page: application deadline, workplace, categories, description, contact person and apply link (see Details mode below). ## Use with AI Agents (MCP) Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents. **Apify MCP server URL:** `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/techjob-dk-jobs-scraper` **Example prompt once connected:** > "Use `techjob-dk-jobs-scraper` to find up to 5 jobs for the keyword "python" (Python jobs in Denmark). Return results as a table with title, company, location and job URL." Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) receive the full input schema automatically. ## Input Every field is optional. Example: ```json { "maxResults": 5, "maxResultsPerQuery": 5, "searchQueries": [ "python" ] } ``` | Field | What it does | |---|---| | `searchQueries` | Keywords such as python, embedded, projektleder or data engineer. Each keyword is its own search. Leave empty to list the newest jobs or the jobs that match the filters. | | `startUrls` | Result page addresses of the site, for example https://techjob.dk/jobs?keywords=python. The parameters are kept and the pages are read from the page the address points to. Only https://techjob.dk/jobs addresses work. | | `categories` | Job categories by the site's Danish name or numeric id (list below). Each category is its own search. | | `jobTypes` | Fastansættelse, Praktikplads, Studiejob, Projektsamarbejde, Freelance-opgave, Graduate-stilling, Projektansættelse or Senkarriere. permanent, internship, student, freelance and graduate work too. | | `languages` | da (Danish) or en (English): the language the job is written in. | | `locations` | Town or city to search around, for example Aarhus. Each location is its own search. | | `radiusKm` | Distance around each location in km. 0 uses the site's own default of 5 km. Only used with a location. | | `companies` | Company names as shown on TechJob, for example Novafos. Each company is its own search. | | `deadlineWithin` | Only jobs whose application deadline falls within 1, 3, 7 or 30 days. | | `sortBy` | relevance or date (newest first). | | `maxResultsPerQuery` | Jobs per keyword and filter combination. Default 50, up to 1000. | | `maxResults` | Jobs in total. Default 200. 0 means no limit. | | `includeDetails` | Default false. Reads the job page of every job for the detail columns. One extra page fetch per job, so runs are slower. Only some jobs are hosted on TechJob (see below). | A list filter with several values runs one search per value and returns every job once. A filter value that matches nothing (a category that does not exist, for example) returns 0 jobs instead of being ignored. The site returns 10 jobs per page and the actor reads about one page per second. ### Categories The category filter uses the checkboxes of the site. A main group and its sub categories: - **Byggeri, Anlæg & Infrastruktur** (29774): Byggeri (863), Trafikanlæg (29853), Konstruktioner (2056), Anlæg (1307), Teknisk dokumentation (29744), Bygningsdesign (29742), Byplanlægning (235), HVAC (29707), Facility management (29690), Bygningsdrift (29782), Bygningsarkitektur (29207), Maritime teknologier (29708), Beton (1899), Bygningssikring (29597), Ventilation (29968), Landskabsarkitektur (29783), Måleteknik (29794) - **Digitalisering, AI & Udvikling** (29909): Webudvikling (29796), Software (184), Programmering (29671), Digital design (29692), Digital analyse (29820), Kunstig intelligens (433), Digitalisering (52), Embedded software (29709), Styresystemer (29832), Optimering (29931), Privacy (193), Internet of Things (29728), Spiludvikling (2184) - **Elektronik & IT-infrastruktur** (29603): It-infrastruktur (2031), El-teknik (29777), Cloud (1073), It-netværk (29731), Hardware (660), El-ingeniør (29762), Droner (249), Trådløse netværk (29798), Laser (2068), Lydelektronik (29641) - **Energi, Forsyning & Miljø** (29631): Miljøteknologi (29904), Vandsystemer (29607), Drift (29642), Elforsyning (213), Energiforsyning (29606), Forurening (625), Bæredygtig energi (29823), Energiadministration (29749), Forsyning (29898), Natur (2103), Affaldshåndtering (29965), Varmeforsyning (29932) - **Forskning & Naturvidenskab** (29678): Informationsvidenskab (29899), Geovidenskab (29872), Matematik (2086), Forskning (785), Fysik (1991), Undervisning (29733), Kemi (2049), R&D (29781), Systemanalyse (29609) - **It-sikkerhed & Compliance** (29664): Kvalitetssikring (29873), It-sikkerhed (1131), GDPR (145), Risikovurdering (29767), Compliance (137), Kryptoanalyse (29610), Firewall (29948), Identity and Access Management (29918), Kryptologi (29864), Malware (2082) - **Ledelse** (666): Projektledelse (403), Byggeledelse (29611), It-ledelse (29735), Strategi (1042), Produktledelse (29649), Team- og afdelingsledelse (29737), HR (1887), Risikostyring (29906), Ledelsessystemer (29800), Director (29666), Teamledelse (29913), Planlægning (29989), Bæredygtig udvikling (29647), Driftsledelse (29933), Leverandørstyring (29988), Energiledelse (29961), Innovation (758) - **Life science** (27966): Farmakologi (29866), Laboratoriearbejde (29652), Biologi (1904), Sundhedsteknologi (29962), Fødevareteknologi (29883) - **Maskiner & Produktion** (29964): Maskindesign (29722), Automatisering (29967), Produktionsteknologier (29618), Ingeniør (29771), Procesteknik (29884), Procesoptimering (29876), Supply chain (29686), Mekanik (29654), Industrielt design (29815), Køle- og varmesystemer (29928) - **Salg, Markedsføring & Administration** (29977): Kommunikation (29915), Forsvarsteknologi (29941), Marketing (29741), Markedsudvikling (29724), Økonomi (29322), Forvaltning (29945), Markedsanalyse (29620), Salg (29773), Administration (29978), Service (29877), Kunderådgivning (29656), Udbudsmateriale (29885), Fundraising (29908), Markedsovervågning (29687) ## Sample output ```json { "id": "107188", "title": "Projektleder / Fagkoordinator til regnvandsbassiner", "slug": "projektleder-fagkoordinator-til-regnvandsbassiner", "company": "Novafos", "company_slug": "novafos", "company_url": "https://techjob.dk/virksomhed/novafos", "company_logo": "https://techjob.dk/sites/mi/files/styles/job_logo/public/2018-05/novafos_360x180.jpg?itok=CtgLrxNr", "employment_type": "Fastansættelse", "location": "Birkerød", "locations": [ "Birkerød" ], "new_job": true, "top_job": true, "job_url": "https://techjob.dk/job/projektleder-fagkoordinator-til-regnvandsbassiner-107188", "search_query": "python", "source": "techjob.dk", "scraped_at": "2026-11-11T10:00:00Z", "details_fetched": null, "hosted_on_techjob": null, "application_deadline": null, "application_deadline_text": null, "posted_date": null, "posted_date_text": null, "workplace": null, "categories": null, "description_text": null, "description_html": null, "apply_url": null, "contact_name": null, "contact_email": null } ``` In list mode the 13 detail columns are null, as above. ## Details mode Set `"includeDetails": true` to read the job page of each job. Each job costs one extra page fetch, and only some jobs are hosted on TechJob: roughly 2 of 5 have a full ad on techjob.dk. The other jobs forward to the employer's own application system. For those the actor reads only the redirect address, saves it as `apply_url`, sets `hosted_on_techjob` to false and does not open the employer's page. `contact_name` and `contact_email` are the contact person that the employer publishes on the TechJob job page. Use them with the data protection rules that apply to you. ```json { "searchQueries": ["python"], "maxResults": 5, "includeDetails": true } ``` A hosted job looks like this (shortened): ```json { "id": "107132", "title": "Chief Technology Officer", "company": "proprty.ai", "employment_type": "Fastansættelse", "location": "København", "details_fetched": true, "hosted_on_techjob": true, "application_deadline": "2027-01-06", "application_deadline_text": "6. jan 2027", "posted_date": "2026-11-06", "posted_date_text": "6. nov 2026", "workplace": "København", "categories": ["Digitalisering, AI & Udvikling", "Platform design", "Kunstig intelligens", "It-udvikling", "Ledelse", "Fullstack"], "description_text": "Lead engineering at a profitable, funded proptech while the team is still small enough to shape. ...", "description_html": "
Lead engineering at a profitable, funded proptech ...
...", "apply_url": "https://techjob.dk/job/apply/107132", "contact_name": "Anna Example", "contact_email": "contact@example.dk" } ``` A job that forwards to an employer site has `details_fetched` true, `hosted_on_techjob` false and its `apply_url` set; all other detail columns are null. When a job page cannot be loaded (blocked, error), `details_fetched` is false, the other detail columns are null, the list data stays and the job is still delivered and charged once. Every job is one `job-result` event, with or without details. ## Fields | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| | `id` | string | Number at the end of the job address /job/-. It is the dedup key. | | `title` | string | Job title as shown on the list. | | `slug` | string | Text part of the job address, without the id. | | `company` | string, null | Hiring company as shown on the list. | | `company_slug` | string, null | Text part of the company page address /virksomhed/. | | `company_url` | string, null | Company page on TechJob with all its jobs. | | `company_logo` | string, null | Logo image URL of the job. | | `employment_type` | string, null | Job type as shown on the list: Fastansættelse (permanent), Praktikplads (internship), Studiejob (student job) and so on. | | `location` | string, null | Place or places of the job as shown on the list, for example "Karup, Aalborg, Ballerup". | | `locations` | array | The location text split on commas. Empty when the job shows no place. | | `new_job` | boolean | True when the job carries the "Nyt job" (new job) mark. | | `top_job` | boolean | True when the job carries the "Top job" mark. | | `job_url` | string | Address of the job on techjob.dk. It forwards to the employer's own application page. | | `search_query` | string | Keyword, filter label or start URL that found the job, or "all jobs" for a search without keyword. | | `source` | string | Site the job comes from (techjob.dk). | | `scraped_at` | string | Time of the scrape, ISO 8601 UTC. | | `details_fetched` | boolean, null | Details mode only: true when the job page was read, false when it could not be loaded. Null in list mode. | | `hosted_on_techjob` | boolean, null | Details mode only: true when the full ad is on techjob.dk, false when the job forwards to an employer site. Null in list mode. | | `application_deadline` | string, null | Details mode, hosted jobs: application deadline as ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Null otherwise. | | `application_deadline_text` | string, null | Details mode, hosted jobs: the deadline as shown, in Danish, for example "6. jan 2027". | | `posted_date` | string, null | Details mode, hosted jobs: posting date (Indrykket) as ISO date. | | `posted_date_text` | string, null | Details mode, hosted jobs: the posting date as shown, for example "6. nov 2026". | | `workplace` | string, null | Details mode, hosted jobs: workplace (Arbejdsplads) as shown. | | `categories` | array, null | Details mode, hosted jobs: the categories (Kategorier) of the job. | | `description_text` | string, null | Details mode, hosted jobs: the job description as plain text (the ad only, no menus). | | `description_html` | string, null | Details mode, hosted jobs: the job description as HTML. | | `apply_url` | string, null | Details mode: the address the job forwards to (external jobs) or the apply link of the page (hosted jobs). | | `contact_name` | string, null | Details mode, hosted jobs: contact person named in the ad. | | `contact_email` | string, null | Details mode, hosted jobs: contact e-mail address of the ad. | The 13 detail columns after `scraped_at` are null unless `includeDetails` is on. There are 29 fields in total. ## Pricing This Actor uses pay per event. There is a small `apify-actor-start` event when a run starts and one `job-result` event for each job in the dataset. You are never charged for a job twice, and a run stops when it reaches the maximum charge you set. Price: $0.001 start fee per run, then $0.0015 per job result ($1.50 per 1,000 jobs). **New to Apify?** Every account gets a $5 free monthly platform credit, enough to try this actor at no cost. ## Related Actors - [Jobindex.dk Job Scraper - Danish Jobs](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/jobindex-dk-scraper): Danish job listings from Jobindex. - [Arbetsförmedlingen Scraper: Platsbanken Swedish Jobs](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/arbetsformedlingen-se-scraper): Swedish jobs from the public Platsbanken. - [NoFluffJobs.com EU Scraper - Engineering Jobs & Salaries](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/nofluffjobs-eu-scraper): Engineering jobs and salaries from NoFluffJobs. - [SwissDevJobs.ch Scraper - Swiss Tech & Developer Jobs](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/swissdevjobs-ch-scraper): Swiss tech and developer jobs. ## FAQ **Why is there no posting date, salary or description by default?** The list of TechJob shows only the title, company, job type, location and the marks. Turn on `includeDetails` to read the job page: it gives the deadline, posting date, workplace, categories, description and contact for the jobs hosted on TechJob. Jobs that forward to the employer's own site get only their apply link, because the actor does not open the employer's page. TechJob shows no salary. **Which filters can I combine?** All of them. Categories, job types, languages, locations and companies accept several values: each value is read as its own search and a job found twice is returned once. With several keywords, each keyword runs as its own search too. **What happens when a keyword finds nothing?** The run ends normally with the status "0 jobs found for ." and nothing is charged. **Why are some locations several places in one text?** Some jobs list several places, for example "Karup, Aalborg, Ballerup". `location` keeps the text as shown and `locations` splits it on commas. **How many jobs does the site have?** A few hundred are open at a time (the list page says "Viser N job"). Use the filters to narrow them down. ## Support Something broken, or a field you wish this Actor returned? Open a ticket on the Actor's [Issues tab](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/techjob-dk-jobs-scraper/issues) or email contact@nanoscrape.com. We usually respond within one working day.
